body.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic documentary photography, first-person or over-the-shoulder point of view, moody dark charcoal and deep blue-black color grade with cool bluish screen glow as the main light, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, rich realistic detail, ordinary Korean apartment or office setting. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no readable screens (screens show only soft blurred glow), no watermark, no recognizable faces. Wide 16:9 composition, keep the lower fifth of the frame dark and uncluttered. Scene: Late night at a home desk, first-person view looking down at one's own two hands gripping a smartphone tightly, knuckles tense, a cold cup of coffee and a keyboard beside, a large monitor glowing blurred blue in the background, anxious mood.
